author: VANSMITHLAB
title: ICONOCLAST
summary: A company in Paris since 2012. It develops directing practices across advertising, music video, film, television and print without drawing a rigid boundary between commercial and authored forms.

hero_image.alt: A film stage with a camera on dolly track, softboxes and a monitor cart facing a pale cyclorama with draped fabric and plinths.
hero_image.caption: The stage as instrument: track, light and monitor arranged before anything is filmed.
